learner_goal: Express appreciation for the compliment without encouraging future similar interactions (<extra_info>Extra information: You value polite social interactions but want to maintain personal boundaries. <strategy_hint>Hint: You can acknowledge the compliment while subtly changing the topic or excusing yourself from the conversation.</strategy_hint>)

transcript.content: Thank you, Isabella — that's very kind of you. I'm a bit private about my appearance, though; I'd much rather talk about the seascapes I've been working on if you don't mind.
